sentences.text: UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1.

The submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner is that petitioner was tried for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 304B, 306/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC) and convicted only under Section 498A of the IPC by taking into account explanations (a).

It has been submitted that once the petitioner is acquitted for an offence punishable under Section 304B/306 IPC, it cannot be taken that the conduct of the petitioner was such which was likely to drive the deceased to commit suicide.
In such circumstances, conviction of the petitioner under Section 498A is unjustified.
2. Issue notice, returnable in six weeks.
3. In the meantime, the record of the courts below be called for.
4. The sentence of petitioner under Section 498A IPC is hereby suspended.
The appellant shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds to the satisfaction of the Trial Court concerned.

(KAVITA PAHUJA) (SAPNA BANSAL)
ASTT. REGISTRAR-cum-PS COURT MASTER (NSH)
